tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Derivative bound for the length of the radial family] \[ \frac{dl}{dt}(t)\le \max _\psi h(\psi ) \int _{\lambda (t)}k_{\mathrm{geod}}\, ds. \] \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch The base meets the radial sides orthogonally, so every radial contraction does also. Its first length variation is $\int k_{\mathrm{geod}}h|\cos \theta |ds$, which gives the estimate.

□
